subject: Discovery recap + proposed rotating demo cadence (US/EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@carepoint.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@carepoint.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed rotating demo cadence (US/EU/APAC)

Thanks again for the conversation today — really appreciated the context on CarePoint's deployment model and where inference is mission-critical for your triage workflows. Quick recap and a suggested next step to lock in the technical deep-dive.

Recap (high level):
- Primary goal: reduce end-to-end latency for clinical triage summaries (~sub-500ms target for inference p50) and reduce token cost on bulk batch runs.
- Key constraints: need private deployment (VPC), SOC 2 evidence, and predictable throughput during business hours (US/EU).
- Stakeholders: Alex (product/PO), Priya (platform/infra), plus SRE and security in later calls.
- Timeline: vendor short-listing by end of July; technical evals in July.

Proposed next step: a 60-minute technical deep-dive + demo focused on deployment options and latency/cost tradeoffs. Because you have teams across US/EU/APAC, I wanted to propose a rotating, repeatable meeting cadence so we can share the same demo material but rotate the time-of-day each week to be fair to all time zones. Two quick templates below — let me know which you prefer (or if you want different windows):

Option A — Weekly rotating baton (recommended)
- Week 1: US-friendly slot (10:00 PT / 13:00 ET) — good for US-based product/dev teams
- Week 2: EMEA-friendly slot (15:00 BST / 16:00 CEST) — better for European infra
- Week 3: APAC-friendly slot (09:00 SGT / 11:00 AEST) — rotates to catch APAC mornings

Option B — Fixed twice-weekly split
- One recurring US/EMEA overlap slot (13:00 PT / 21:00 CEST) every Tue
- One APAC-focused slot (08:00 SGT) every Thu

If you prefer Option A, we can schedule the first three sessions as a pilot and then decide cadence (weekly vs biweekly) after two runs. I included two attachments: a short Redwood one-pager and our demo guide so you and the infra folks can skim ahead.

Proposed first slots (please reply with preferred option + concrete availability):
- Tue Jun 24 — 10:00 PT / 18:00 CEST
- Wed Jun 25 — 16:00 BST / 00:00 SGT (less ideal for APAC)
- Thu Jun 26 — 08:00 SGT / 20:00 CEST

Quick logistical asks for the deep-dive:
- Will SRE want access to a sample workload or logs? If so, please share preferred secure transfer (S3 access or private upload).
- Any specific models or sequence lengths you want us to include in the demo (short chat vs batch summarization)?

Thanks — looping in Ben and Camila to coordinate the demo engineers. I’ll hold the times once you confirm which option you prefer.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-demo-guide.pdf (PDF)

- Our SRE lead (not on this thread yet) prefers weekly cadence during evaluation to iterate faster, but product prefers biweekly to reduce meeting fatigue. Is it possible to run weekly for first month then move to biweekly?
- For the demo, we need to see both a hosted flow and a dedicated/VPC deployment sketch. Can you include the template network diagram in the deep-dive?
- Tentative availability from our side next week (all local times BST):
  - Tue Jun 24 — 17:00–18:30 BST (works if you can do early US)
  - Thu Jun 26 — 09:00–10:00 BST (this works well for our infra)

If you can propose a concrete Week 1/2/3 schedule (UTC times would be easiest), we’ll confirm and surface to SRE.

On the attachments — skimmed the one-pager and demo guide; both look good.

—Alex
